{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check sex distribution in treatment arm
treatment_sex = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['sex'].value_counts()
print(treatment_sex)

# Check if any females in treatment arm
has_females_in_treatment = 'F' in treatment_sex.index
print(f"Are there any female patients in the treatment arm? {has_females_in_treatment}")"}
